name: Cardiology
description: Diagnosis and management of heart conditions, including coronary artery disease, hypertension, heart failure and heart rhythm disorders. The department also provides cardiac services such as pacemaker implantation, where clinically indicated.

name: Cardiothoracic & Vascular Surgery
description: Surgical treatment for conditions affecting the heart, chest and major blood vessels. This includes heart surgery, chest (thoracic) surgery, and vascular and endovascular procedures such as stenting and EVAR, a repair of a swollen aorta from inside the blood vessel.

name: Medical Oncology
description: Medical treatment for different types of cancer, including chemotherapy and other drug-based therapies. Treatment plans are based on the type and stage of cancer and the individual patient's needs.

name: Surgical Oncology
description: Surgical treatment for cancer, with procedures planned according to the type, location and stage of the disease. Care may be coordinated with medical oncology and other specialists as part of the patient's treatment plan.

name: Paediatric Oncology
description: Specialist care for infants, children and adolescents diagnosed with cancer. The department focuses on diagnosis, treatment planning and ongoing care for childhood cancers.

name: Neurology
description: Diagnosis and medical treatment of conditions affecting the brain, spinal cord and nerves, including stroke, epilepsy, headaches and migraine, nerve damage (neuropathy) and movement disorders such as Parkinson's disease. The team also provides care for patients with urgent neurological conditions in the emergency department and intensive care unit.

name: Neurosurgery
description: Surgical treatment for conditions affecting the brain, spine and nervous system, including brain and spinal tumours, head injuries and spinal disorders.

name: Gastroenterology
description: Diagnosis and treatment of problems with the food pipe (oesophagus), stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder, including endoscopy, which uses a thin camera to look inside the digestive tract.

name: Nephrology
description: Medical care for acute and chronic kidney disease, kidney-related high blood pressure and complications of kidney failure. The department also manages the hospital’s Dialysis Unit, providing regular haemodialysis and dialysis support for critically ill patients in intensive care.

name: Urology
description: Diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the kidneys, bladder and urinary tract, as well as the male reproductive system. These include kidney stones, urinary tract infections and prostate conditions. The department also provides care for urinary problems in women and children, along with reconstructive urological procedures.

name: General Medicine
description: Diagnosis and treatment of common illnesses, infections, chronic conditions and other adult health concerns.

name: General & Laparoscopic Surgery
description: Surgical care for conditions that may require conventional or minimally invasive procedures.

name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
description: Healthcare for women at different stages of life, including pregnancy, childbirth and gynaecological conditions.

name: Paediatrics
description: Medical care for infants, children and adolescents, including the diagnosis and treatment of childhood illnesses.

name: Orthopaedics
description: Treatment and management of conditions affecting bones, joints, muscles and the musculoskeletal system, including injuries and fractures.

name: Diabetology
description: Care for people with diabetes, including blood sugar management, monitoring and guidance on preventing complications.

name: Pulmonology
description: Diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the lungs and respiratory system, including asthma and other breathing disorders.

name: ENT
description: Medical and surgical care for conditions affecting the ear, nose and throat.

name: Ophthalmology
description: Eye examinations, vision care and treatment of eye conditions.

name: Dermatology
description: Diagnosis and treatment of skin, hair and nail conditions.

name: Dental & Maxillofacial Surgery
description: Dental care and treatment of conditions affecting the teeth, mouth, jaw and facial structures.

name: Psychiatry
description: Assessment and treatment of mental health conditions, with support for emotional and psychological wellbeing.

name: Palliative Medicine
description: Care focused on relieving pain and other symptoms, improving comfort and supporting patients and families living with serious illnesses.

name: Ayurveda
description: Traditional Ayurvedic healthcare and treatment based on individual health needs.

name: Emergency Medicine
description: Round-the-clock medical attention for accidents, injuries and sudden illnesses. Our emergency team is available 24 hours a day.

name: Anaesthesiology
description: Anaesthesia and pain management services for patients undergoing surgical and other medical procedures.

name: Radiology & Imaging
description: Diagnostic imaging services, including X-rays, ultrasound and CT scans, to help doctors investigate and assess medical conditions.

name: Microbiology
description: Laboratory testing to identify bacteria, viruses, fungi and other microorganisms that may cause infections.

name: EECP
description: Enhanced External Counterpulsation (EECP) is a non-invasive treatment used for selected patients with certain heart conditions. Treatment suitability is assessed by a cardiologist.

name: Physiotherapy
description: Rehabilitation and physical therapy to help patients improve movement, strength and function after illness, injury or surgery.

name: Dietetics
description: Personalised nutritional guidance to support patients with medical conditions, during treatment and throughout recovery.
